features: Pentabrid video input: AHD, CVI, TVI, analog (CVBS) and IP cameras
Hardware compression: H.264; the feature list names H.265+ as optional
Supported cameras: HD analog 1080P/960P/720P, IP 2.0MP/1.3MP/1.0MP, analog 1200H/960H
Email alerts on motion detection, video loss and video blind
notes: Pentabrid mode: 8CH = 4CH (AHD, CVI, TVI, CVBS) + 4CH IP. NVR mode: 8CH @ WD1 (960H), 4CH @ Full HD (1080P), or 1CH Full HD + 8CH HD (720P). No single maximum IP channel count is stated, so the IP channel count is left out.
